question: Who is the Controller General of Accounts (CGA) as on 15th June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonali Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonali Singh** was appointed as the Controller General of Accounts (**CGA**) on **15th June 2022**.
 
• The Controller General of Accounts (CGA) is the principal advisor on accounting matters to the Government of India and is responsible for establishing and maintaining a technically sound management accounting system.
 
• The CGA is also responsible for the preparation and submission of the accounts of the Union Government, including the Union Finance Accounts and the Appropriation Accounts.
 
• Sonali Singh has held various key positions in the Indian Civil Accounts Service (ICAS) and has been instrumental in implementing several reforms in government accounting and financial management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Controller General of Accounts (CGA) is a position under the **Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance**, Government of India.
 
• The CGA plays a crucial role in managing the Consolidated Fund of India, the Contingency Fund of India, and the Public Account of India.
 
• The office of CGA was created in 1976, and it has since been pivotal in enhancing transparency and accountability in government financial operations.
 
• The CGA also oversees the implementation of the Government Financial Management System (GFMS), which aims to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of government financial management.
 
• The CGA's office is responsible for the maintenance of accounts of the central government and provides financial advice to various ministries and departments.
